calculationMethod: For each included ingredient, each USDA SR Legacy source value is multiplied by the listed recipe quantity divided by 100; contribution amounts are rounded to two decimals, summed, and divided by the recipe serving count. Listed millilitre quantities are treated as grams for per-100 g source records; density and cooking yield are not modeled. Nutrients absent from a selected source row are not imputed. Unsupported forms and water are listed as exclusions rather than silently substituted.
